name: wp-banner-dev
description: Development tools for WP Banner (not part of the plugin zip): the browser tests in tests/motion.cjs (Chrome) and tests/engines.cjs (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit: npx playwright-core install firefox webkit once); npm run pot writes languages/wp-banner.pot.

scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:browser && npm run test:engines
